values.transfers: (() => { const captures = [gained, ...merge.members.map(member => member.gained)]; const gains = captures.filter(Boolean).length; const losses = captures.length - gains; const times = n => n === 1 ? 'once' : n === 2 ? 'twice' : n + ' times'; return gains && losses ? 'We gained the city ' + times(gains) + ' and lost it ' + times(losses) + '.' : gains ? 'We gained the city ' + times(gains) + '.' : 'We lost the city ' + times(losses) + '.'; })()
values.holder: event.city.own ? ' The latest report puts it under our flag.' : event.city.get('owner.name') ? ' At last report, it was held by ' + event.city.get('owner.name') + '.' : ''

variants.headline: Flags change over {{city}}
body: This office has reported {{city}} changing hands more than once, and each report went to print as it arrived. {{merge.values.transfers}}{{merge.values.holder}} Folk there have learned to leave the gate unpainted until they are sure who holds it next.

variants.headline: {{terms.civilization}} takes control of {{city}}
body: {{city}} has fallen to {{terms.civilization}}. Our forces moved in from the outskirts and secured the city center after the defense by {{formerOwner}} collapsed. Local leaders are awaiting further instructions from {{terms.civic.leaderAddress}}.

variants.headline: {{city}} falls to {{captor}}
body: Forces from {{captor}} have taken {{city}}, previously a stronghold of {{terms.civilization}}, after a sustained assault. Observers report that the transition occurred quickly. Local {{terms.civic.people}} are now adjusting to the administration of {{captor}}.

variants.headline: The Fall of {{city}}
body: The capture of {{city}} provides {{terms.civilization}} with a vital strategic pivot. While {{formerOwner}} may claim the loss is merely a border adjustment, this victory transforms a defense hub into a launchpad for further expansion.

variants.headline: Disaster at {{city}}
body: {{captor}} has seized {{city}}! Was the {{terms.civic.government}} asleep while the enemy marched? Our {{terms.civic.people}} pay the price for this negligence. We demand to know why our defenses were so weak!

variants.headline: {{city}} switches allegiance to {{newOwner}}
body: {{city}}, formerly under the control of {{formerOwner}}, has flipped its loyalty to {{newOwner}}. The change in governance happened without a major battle. Local officials cite a shift in political will as the reason for the change. {{newOwner}} has already begun installing their own administrators.

variants.headline: A New Flag Over {{city}}
body: {{city}} has officially flipped its allegiance from {{formerOwner}} to {{newOwner}}. Records indicate a swift transition of power, with local magistrates swearing loyalty to their new sovereign almost immediately after the announcement.

variants.headline: A New Chapter for {{city}}
body: Madam, letters from the frontier relate that {{city}} now serves {{newOwner}} instead of {{formerOwner}}. I pray that our {{terms.civic.leaderAddress}} extends a gracious hand to the inhabitants: by treating our new neighbors with kindness, we ensure that the drums of war remain silent.

variants.headline: GOODBYE {{formerOwner}}!
body: The tavern keeper in {{city}} changed the sign on his door. He’s serving {{newOwner}}'s beer now. A few coins at hand, he says it tastes better than the stuff from {{formerOwner}}.

variants.headline: {{liberator}} liberates {{liberated}}
body: {{city}} has been liberated from its occupiers by the forces of {{liberator}}. The city is now returning to the control of {{liberated}}. Crowds gathered in the streets to welcome the return of their own administration.

variants.headline: {{liberator}} secures {{city}}
body: Military units under {{liberator}} have successfully liberated {{city}}. The city was formally handed back to the {{terms.civilizationAdjective}} administration this morning. While the streets are celebratory, the army remains on high alert to ensure the perimeter is fully secure.

variants.headline: {{city}} returned to {{liberated}}
body: {{liberator}} has liberated {{city}} and formally returned it to the control of {{liberated}}. The handover took place at the city hall, where commanders from both nations signed the transfer documents. This move is seen as a significant shift in the regional balance of power.

variants.headline: The restoration of {{city}}
body: We are credibly informed that the forces of {{liberator}} have lately secured {{city}}, restoring its governance to the rightful administration of {{liberated}}. Such a gesture of goodwill surely strengthens the ties of friendship between these two powers and promises a more tranquil era for the local populace.

variants.headline: Justice Triumphs at {{city}}!
body: At last, {{city}} returns to the people of {{liberated}}! Our {{terms.civic.government}} has proven that {{terms.civilizationAdjective}} steel serves the cause of justice. Who can deny our greatness now? Let us hold our heads high, {{terms.civic.people}}, for we have liberated the oppressed!

variants.headline: {{owner}} integrates {{city}}
body: {{owner}} has completed the annexation of {{city}}. The city has lost its semi-autonomous status under {{owner}}.

variants.headline: {{owner}} tightens its hold on {{city}}
body: A puppet bargains; a province obeys. {{city}} has just changed from one to the other, and {{owner}} now rules it from the capital. It answers to the capital directly now, so a decision that once took a season of bargaining will now take a week.

variants.headline: Foreign Grip Tightens {{distance}} Away
body: The semi-autonomous status of {{city}} has ended as {{owner}} completes a full annexation. The city now answers directly to {{owner.civic.leaderTitle}} {{city.owner.leader}}. With {{city}} now fully integrated, {{owner}} has solidified a position just {{distance}} from our borders.

variants.headline: A change of rule in {{city}}
body: Word is given that {{city}}, lately a puppet, now answers to {{owner}} directly. The garrison has not changed and the ceremonies were brief. What has changed is who may give orders, and how quickly they arrive.

variants.headline: {{city}} comes under direct rule
body: The annexation of {{city}} is complete. The city, previously semi-autonomous, is now under the direct control of {{owner}}. Local officials are now reporting to the {{owner.civic.government}}.

variants.headline: The End of Autonomy for {{city}}
body: {{city}} has been fully annexed by {{owner}}, ending its period as a semi-autonomous state. The {{owner.civic.government}} now exercises direct control over all local administration and taxation. The {{owner.civic.people}} in {{city}} may now find themselves subject to the full weight of the state's bureaucracy, potentially sparking the very unrest the previous system sought to avoid.

variants.headline: Resistance continues in {{city}}
body: Despite being under occupation, {{city}} continues to resist. Reports indicate the unrest is widespread, with local populations refusing to cooperate with {{terms.civilizationAdjective}} occupying forces. This resistance is expected to last for {{turns}} more.

variants.headline: The Unbroken Spirit of {{city}}
body: With {{population}} in the crosshairs, the people of {{city}} refuse to bow to the {{owner.civic.government}}. Resistance is expected to hold for another {{turns}}, a testament to the loyalty they still hold for {{formerOwner}}. The {{owner.civic.leaderAddress}} may hold the walls, but they have failed to capture the hearts of the occupied.

variants.headline: The old loyalty runs deep in {{city}}
body: In the market at {{city}}, a fishwife still gives her prices in {{formerOwner}}'s coin. Nobody in the queue corrects her, and the prefect's men walk past without a word. She says the city will need {{turns}} more of our rule before she learns the new money, and she does not sound hurried.

variants.headline: {{city}} Defies {{owner}}'s Control
body: Loyalty to {{formerOwner}} remains strong in {{city}}, where the occupation is meeting public defiance. Local stability has dropped by {{unrestPoints}}, leading to frequent disruptions of {{owner.civic.government}} administration. Current projections suggest the city will remain in resistance for {{turns}}.
